References / Poster / 549

Studio Cryo, Drumstation vs. Eternia poster, Cross Club 2018

A dark event poster with a red line-up band at the top and a rendered collage of clear plastic, smoke, rock, and dripping flowers.

Source
AIGA Eye on Design (5 September 2019): “Acid Graphics” Are the New Psychedelia
Creator
Studio Cryo (Mindaugas Gavrilovas)
Made
2018 (Eye on Design file name and caption). The poster gives the date “07.12”.
Style
Acid graphics (agent-proposed, not yet reviewed by a person)
Moods
Nocturnal, eerie, dense
Evidence
Inspected the 1200 px image Studio-Cryo-Drumstation-VS-Eternia-event-Cross-Club-2018.jpg that Eye on Design published with the article, in a scratch folder. Not stored. The object is a digital image as the magazine published it, not a named physical copy. Eye on Design names Mindaugas Gavrilovas and Studio Cryo in the article text.
Reviewed
2 October 2026
Rights
Link and metadata only. License: unverified. Rights policy

Context

Eye on Design names Studio Cryo and Mindaugas Gavrilovas in its 2019 article and shows this poster, captioned as the Drumstation vs. Eternia event at Cross Club, 2018.

Observed

  • A red band at the top holds “DRUMSTATION VS. ETERNIA” in heavy grotesque capitals, “CROSS CLUB 07.12” in a thin, flared display face, and two blocks of small capitals with the line-up.
  • A red rule separates the band from a near-black image field.
  • The field holds rendered, transparent plastic shapes with engraved circles, a brown rock surface, a plume of orange smoke, and a bunch of red and white flowers that drip blue and white paint.
  • A perforated mesh surface crosses the lower right.
  • There is no green and no chrome type.

Why it belongs

The poster shows the rendered-object side of the trend: glossy clear materials, smoke, and drips on black, with a dense club line-up. It shares the mood and the rendering, not the chrome lettering.

Borrow

Confine all type to one dense band, and give the rest of the sheet to a single rendered scene on black.

Pair a heavy grotesque with a thin flared display face in the same band.
